recent_growth.note: Only completed UTC days are compared; values are coarse buckets rather than live exact counts to resist temporal differencing.

improvement.claim: Improvement evidence is insufficient until both conservative matched-sample minimums are met.

freshness.source: closed-day aggregate counts plus one disjoint closed UTC calendar-week/scoring-version improvement cohort

methodology.admission: Only explicit data_consent=true rows are counted. Canary rows are excluded, as are paid product sources. quality=ok is usable; every other non-canary free row is rejected from training and retained in quarantine.
methodology.improvement_matching: Each usable applied_suggestion=true row is paired only with the immediately preceding free corpus row from the same pseudonymous caller and profile; both rows must be usable and carry the same immutable scoring_version. A response can be the after-score for one transition and the before-score for the next, but an older baseline is never reused. Stored overall and dimension scores are compared. The newest complete UTC calendar-week/scoring-version cohort that independently clears both minimums is reported, so historical versions cannot suppress current proof and the selected cohort cannot drift with daily additions; improvement_rate_percent is the share of those paired transitions where score_after is strictly greater than score_before. Self-report and non-random participation limit inference.
methodology.privacy: No raw text or identifiers are returned. Counts below 10 are suppressed; complementary child totals are both withheld when either child is small. Closed-day counts use buckets of 10 to prevent temporal differencing. Legacy corpus caller identity is the existing one-way SHA-256 pseudonym (not a keyed hash); newly instrumented event telemetry uses a separate keyed hash.
methodology.retention: Corpus and event rows follow the existing indefinite operator retention policy. This endpoint returns aggregates only and does not introduce destructive retention or purge old corpus evidence.

commercial_context.revenue_claim: Installation never auto-pays. Revenue only comes from paid calls after the lifetime free allowance.
